batch_label: Delivery roll-forward - on-order rows checked against shipvault + vesselfinder (2026-09-17)
reason: Backend had not moved since June 2026. Every on-order row with an IMO was looked up in shipvault (status / delivered date / yard no.) and vesselfinder (AIS-registered name, MMSI, year built). Delivered vessels move to active with their real name; delivery years are corrected to the actual year; undelivered 2026 rows that shipvault now schedules for 2027+ are rolled forward.
